subject: Handoff: LuminaHealth activation playbook & evaluation sprint
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@luminahealth.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: LuminaHealth activation playbook & evaluation sprint

Hi team —

Thanks again for signing; SOW attached (SOW_Lumina_signed.pdf). Per our close call, I’m starting the handoff to Customer Success so we can execute the activation and evaluation sprint over the next three weeks. Quick summary and asks below.

High-level objectives
- Enable LuminaHealth to run a representative evaluation and reach a production readiness decision by 2028-07-10.
- Validate latency, cost, and quality gates in a sandbox with customer data samples.
- Deliver integration checklist, test harness, and an evaluation report with recommendations.

Proposed MAP milestones (attached in MAP-Lumina-20280618.xlsx)
1) Technical kickoff & sandbox access — target: 2028-06-21
2) Integration & baseline run (customer test set) — 2028-06-21 to 2028-06-28
3) Eval sprint (metrics collection + regression tests) — 2028-06-29 to 2028-07-06
4) Review & acceptance gate (product + eng sign-off) — by 2028-07-10

Roles I recommend
- Sales (remains point for commercial): Hannah (me) — escalation and commercial questions
- Customer Success lead: Marissa Cole — activation owner and primary contact for onboarding
- Quality & eval owner: Monica Patel — drives test harness and metric dashboards
- Customer product: Ellie Ramos — product owner for acceptance criteria
- Customer engineering: Mike Chen — owns sandbox connectivity and security contacts

Immediate asks
- Marissa/Monica: can you confirm CS ownership and available lead engineer for the 6/21 kickoff?
- Ellie: please confirm internal stakeholders and add any compliance/security contacts (we need a SOC2 contact for questionnaire).
- Mike: can you confirm target sandbox IPs and that the SOW is in procurement?

Attachments: SOW_Lumina_signed.pdf (commercial), MAP-Lumina-20280618.xlsx (milestones + responsibilities), Lumina_ACTIVATION_v1.pdf (playbook draft).

I’ll schedule the 30–45 minute kickoff for 6/21 10:00am PT and send a calendar invite after I hear back — but if that time doesn’t work, suggest two alternatives.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@luminahealth.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: LuminaHealth activation playbook & evaluation sprint

On Mon, Jun 18, 2028 at 9:02 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi team —
> 
> Thanks again for signing; SOW attached...

Thanks Hannah — looping in the CS technical and delivery owners.

Acknowledged and accepting CS lead for activation: I’ll be the primary owner for onboarding and overall MAP delivery. High-level plan from CS side below; I’ll own the kickoff agenda and run the weekly checkpoints.

CS proposed execution plan
- Owner: Marissa Cole (CS Lead) — overall delivery & customer liaison
- Eval/Test lead: Monica Patel — responsible for test harness, scripts, and metric dashboards
- Tech contact (Redwood infra): Dev Patel (will be on the kickoff for kernel/quant issues)

Week-by-week timeline
- Week 0 (6/21): Technical kickoff, sandbox credentials, SLAs for ephemeral data retention
- Week 1 (6/21–6/28): Integration verification & baseline runs (we’ll deliver a baseline metrics report)
- Week 2 (6/29–7/06): Optimization pass (batching/quantization tuning) and formal eval run
- Acceptance window (7/07–7/10): Final review, acceptance criteria check, and recommended next steps for production rollout

Deliverables
- Baseline metrics (P95 latency, token cost, success rate by prompt set)
- Evaluation report with recommended model variant and configuration
- Runbook and onboarding checklist for production handover

Open questions
- Ellie/Mike: what internal sign-off is required for the acceptance gate (product + security?)
- Procurement: will the signed SOW be available to the procurement team this week?

I’m proposing a technical kickoff on Mon 2028-06-21 at 9:00am PT (move earlier than your suggestion so our infra folks can join); if that’s not possible, Hannah please send options.

Attachments referenced: MAP-Lumina-20280618.xlsx (I added a tab with the detailed task owners).

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

From: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@luminahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: LuminaHealth activation playbook & evaluation sprint

Thanks, Hannah and Marissa — this looks good to me. A few quick notes from Lumina: 

- Stakeholders: Product (me), Eng (Mike Chen), Security (Jared Park <jared.park@luminahealth.com>) — please include Jared on the kickoff invite so he can field the SOC2/data handling questions.
- Procurement: SOW has been uploaded to our procurement portal (I confirmed with procurement); they’re targeting contract acceptance by 6/22.
- Timeline: we’re aiming to complete the evaluation and make a go/no-go decision by 2028-07-10. If CS can provide the baseline metrics report by 6/28, that would be ideal for our internal roadmap review.

One ask: can CS include a short checklist in the kickoff that covers network allowlist, sample data uploads, and how long the KV caches are persisted in the sandbox? Those are the top items our security team will check.

I’m available for the 6/21 9:00am PT kickoff proposed by Marissa. Thanks — looking forward to working together.

—
Ellie Ramos
Head of Product | LuminaHealth
ellie.ramos@luminahealth.com | +1 212-555-0684

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@luminahealth.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@luminahealth.com>, Jared Park <jared.park@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: LuminaHealth activation playbook & evaluation sprint

Thanks everyone — love the clarity. Calendar invite for the technical kickoff (Mon 6/21, 9:00am PT) is sent to all; agenda will include: intro + success criteria, sandbox/network checklist, baseline run plan, and Q&A with Jared.

Next steps (short):
- Marissa: own kickoff and weekly cadence
- Monica: bring test harness and baseline report template to kickoff
- Ellie/Mike/Jared: provide sandbox access and procurement confirmation where applicable

I’ll keep myself on the thread for commercial follow-up and escalation. If any calendar conflicts come up, reply-all with two alternatives and we’ll adjust.

—
Hannah
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
